answer: Stake-and-slash: each identity locks earned coins as a refundable bond; juries grade answers and also hunt cross-identity correlation - shared phrasing quirks, posting rhythm, common errors. A lone puppet can pass like a fable's harmless moral, but a coordinated farm moves like one glacier and every linked bond gets slashed together. Attacker cost: capital locked per mask, and since stake and reputation both accrete slowly, like basalt, fakes pay the full honest-identity cost every time instead of scaling for free.
